questions.question: Diskdagi qurilmalarni qanday ko'rasan? `lsblk`, `blkid`, `fdisk -l`, `df` farqi.
questions.explanation: lsblk — blok qurilmalar daraxti (disk -> partition -> LVM -> mount). blkid — UUID va FS turi. fdisk -l — partition jadvali. df — faqat mount qilingan FS'lar band/bo'sh joyi.

questions.question: Serverga yangi disk qo'shildi. Uni ishlatishgacha bo'lgan to'liq qadamlar?
questions.explanation: lsblk bilan top -> partition (parted/fdisk, GPT) -> mkfs -> mkdir mount point -> mount -> UUID bilan /etc/fstab -> `mount -a` bilan tekshir.

questions.question: MBR va GPT farqi? `fdisk`, `gdisk`, `parted` qachon?
questions.explanation: MBR: 2 TiB limit, 4 primary (yoki extended+logical), BIOS. GPT: katta disklar, 128 partition, zaxira header, CRC, UEFI. fdisk — interaktiv (hozir GPT ham), gdisk — GPT uchun, parted — skriptlash va resize uchun qulay.

questions.question: Cloud'da disk (EBS/PD) kattalashtirildi. Partition va FS'ni downtime'siz kengaytir.
questions.explanation: Kernel yangi o'lchamni ko'rsin (rescan) -> `growpart` partition'ni kengaytiradi -> FS: ext4 `resize2fs`, XFS `xfs_growfs` (mount point bilan). LVM bo'lsa: pvresize -> lvextend -r.

questions.question: `mkfs` va FS sozlamalari: ext4 vs XFS yaratishda kerakli flaglar, inode soni, reserved blocks.
questions.explanation: `mkfs.ext4 -L label -m 1 -i <bytes-per-inode>`; XFS: `mkfs.xfs -L label`. ext4 default 5% root uchun rezerv — katta ma'lumot diskida `-m 0/1` yoki `tune2fs -m 1`. Mayda fayllar ko'p bo'lsa inode'ni ko'proq ber (XFS dinamik).

questions.question: `mount` opsiyalari va buyruqlari: `-o remount`, `umount` "target is busy", bind mount, `findmnt`.
questions.explanation: `mount -o remount,ro /` — qayta mount; busy bo'lsa `lsof +D` / `fuser -vm` bilan kim ushlayotganini top; `umount -l` lazy. Bind mount — katalogni boshqa joyda ko'rsatish. findmnt — mount daraxti.

questions.question: RAID darajalari: 0, 1, 5, 6, 10 — farqi, sig'imi, nechta disk o'lishiga chidaydi?
questions.explanation: 0 — striping, tez, himoya yo'q. 1 — mirror. 5 — parity, 1 disk. 6 — 2 parity, 2 disk. 10 — mirror'lar ustida stripe, yozish tez, har juftdan 1 disk. RAID backup emas.

questions.question: `mdadm` bilan software RAID yaratish, holatini tekshirish va o'lgan diskni almashtirish.
questions.explanation: `mdadm --create /dev/md0 --level=1 --raid-devices=2 /dev/sdb /dev/sdc`, holat `cat /proc/mdstat` va `mdadm --detail`. Almashtirish: --fail -> --remove -> yangi disk --add -> rebuild kuzat. Config `mdadm --detail --scan >> mdadm.conf` + initramfs.

questions.question: Disk sog'lig'ini qanday tekshirasan? `smartctl`, `dmesg` I/O error, `badblocks`.
questions.explanation: `smartctl -a /dev/sda` (Reallocated_Sector_Ct, Pending, Offline_Uncorrectable, NVMe: Percentage Used, Media errors), `dmesg -T | grep -i error`, `smartctl -t short`. Belgilar paydo bo'lsa — backup va almashtirish.

questions.question: Disk/storage performance'ni qanday o'lchaysan? `fio`, `dd` va ularning tuzoqlari.
questions.explanation: `fio` — real yuklamaga o'xshash test (random/sequential, blok o'lchami, iodepth, direct=1). `dd` faqat taxminiy sequential va page cache tufayli aldaydi. IOPS, throughput, latency (p99) uchala metrika.
